name: Unthought Of
description: Ideas nobody asked for and nobody had: a modem that falls in love mid-handshake, a lift whose music climbs with every floor, a lawnmower playing a concerto, a committee that only agrees every eight bars, a choir that sneezes, a tune with the memory of a goldfish, a melody that falls upwards, saucepans ringing changes like a bell tower, an office in seven against eleven, and the heat death of the universe, played once. Every sketch explains its trick in the comments.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Dial-Up Romance
sketches.description: Two bars of a modem handshake (a sweeping carrier ring-modulated into a screech, and hiss crushed to three bits) then the line connects and a tenor sings a love song to it. It happens again every four bars.
sketches.source:
setcpm(90/4)

// Bars 1 and 2 of every four: the handshake. The number is dialled...
dialling: s("<[click*7] ~ ~ ~>").hpf(1000).gain(.15)

// ...then a carrier sweeps and warbles, ring-modulated into a screech
carrier: freq(saw.range(1200, 2400).fast(2).segment(16)).s("square").pw(.3)
  .ringmod("<300 1100 0 0>").ringmix(.5).mask("<1 1 0 0>")
  .decay(.08).sustain(.6).release(.02).gain(.05)

// Hiss crushed to three bits: the line negotiating
hiss: s("white*16?0.5").crush(3).hpf(2000).mask("<0 1 0 0>").seed("modem").gain(.06)

// Connected: a chime, then a tenor sings a love song to the modem
chime: note("<~ ~ [b5 g5 ~ ~] ~>").s("sine").fm(2).fmh(3.5).decay(.6).sustain(0).gain(.12)
lover: note("<~ ~ [g4@3 a4 b4@4] [d5@3 c5 b4@4]>")
  .s("voice").syl("<~ ~ [i@3 la vu@4] [mo@3 de ma@4]>").voicetype("tenor")
  .mono(1).vglide(.1).attack(.08).release(.8).space("hall").gain(.3)

// Soft chords that only come in once the line is up: G, Em
keys: note("<~ ~ [g3,b3,d4] [e3,g3,b3,d4]>").s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2)
  .attack(.2).decay(1).sustain(.4).release(1).room(.5).gain(.2)
bass: note("<~ ~ g2 e2>").s("sine").attack(.05).sustain(.7).release(.5).gain(.3)

sketches.name: Express to the Penthouse
sketches.description: Lift music that climbs one scale degree per floor, with a floor ding that climbs along with it. On the top floor the band panics and plays twice as fast, then the lift drops back to the lobby.

sketches.name: Lawnmower Concerto
sketches.description: A concerto for two-stroke engine and orchestra: the mower takes the solo, pitched by note like any machine, over strings, horns and timpani. Grass clippings fly around you and the neighbour's dog objects from behind.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// The soloist: a lawnmower, pitched by note like any machine, right in front of you
mower: note("<[c3@3 d3 e3@2 g3@2] [a3@4 g3@4] [f3@2 e3 d3 e3@2 c3@2] [d3@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("engine").lpf(2400).distance(1.5).gain(.26)

// The orchestra: C, Am, F, G
strings: note("<[c3,g3,e4] [a2,e3,c4] [f2,c3,a3] [g2,d3,b3]>").s("sawtooth").unison(5).detune(18)
  .attack(.4).sustain(1).release(1.2).lpf(2200).room(.6).gain(.12)
horns: note("<~ [e4@2 g4@2] ~ [d4@2 b3@2]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(900).lpenv(1).lpattack(.1)
  .attack(.1).sustain(.8).release(.6).space("hall").gain(.18)
timpani: note("<[c2 ~ g1 ~] [a1 ~ e2 ~] [f1 ~ c2 ~] [g1 g1 g1 g1]>").s("sine").fm(1.2).fmh(1.5)
  .penv(2).pdecay(.06).decay(1).sustain(0).release(1).space("hall").gain(.4)

// Grass clippings flying all around you
clippings: s("click*16?0.4").hpf(4000).azimuth(rand.range(-180, 180)).distance(2)
  .seed("clippings").gain(.08)

// The neighbour's dog objects, from behind the fence
dog: note("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ a2 a2]>").s("voice").syl("wuf").voicetype("bass").fry(.8)
  .attack(.01).release(.2).azimuth(150).distance(5).gain(.24)

sketches.name: Committee Meeting
sketches.description: Everyone reads the same sentence at once, each at their own speed, so it is babble, except every eight bars, when converge brings them all to the start together, a choir agrees and the gavel comes down.

sketches.name: Sneeze Cantata
sketches.description: A choir swells on three rising chords, ah, ah, ah, then the sneeze: a burst of noise and a whispered shoo. A bass voice says bless you, the organ carries on as if nothing happened.

sketches.name: Goldfish Memory
sketches.description: A tune that forgets itself: subtractive drops one more note every bar, a random forgetting grows over sixteen bars, and a second fish only remembers the first quarter of each bar and keeps repeating it. Bubbles rise and the filter hums.

sketches.name: Gravity Fails
sketches.description: A melody stated, then inverted so it falls upwards, then played backwards, then both. Raindrops fall up past your ears on rising pitch envelopes, and the drums run in reverse.

sketches.name: Kitchen Bell Tower
sketches.description: Six saucepans hung from a rack ring plain hunt, a new order every bar, coming back to rounds after twelve. Wooden spoons run through every ordering of four pots, the fridge hums and the blender joins in every fourth bar.

sketches.name: Please Take a Number
sketches.description: An office in seven against eleven: rubber stamps in seven, typewriters in eleven, a phone that rings and rings, hold music through the wall, a clerk calling next and a buzzer that rejects your form every eight bars.

sketches.name: Heat Death of the Universe
sketches.description: Listen through once. Eight bars of stars, eight of dust, eight of almost nothing: the melody slows and thins, the pad cools and closes, the background noise spreads from a point in your head to everywhere and the last protons decay. Then a 2 Hz binaural drone hums in the void, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning, and fades too.
